info.description: Hugging Face Bio Carbon-X is a 14.8B decoder-only model trained on DNA and natural-language text, with a 40,960-token context window, under the Apache 2.0 license. Input and output are text. The chat template supports enable_thinking, and the model was post-trained and evaluated with thinking disabled. No first-party API price or calendar release date is published.

zh.description: Hugging Face Bio 的 Carbon-X 是 14.8B 解码器模型，在 DNA 与自然语言文本上联合训练，上下文窗口 40,960 tokens，许可证为 Apache 2.0。输入和输出都是文本。对话模板支持 enable_thinking，后训练和评测时关闭思考。官方未公布第一方 API 价格，也没有日历发布日期。
